    THE ANALYSIS FRAMEWORK

    Strategy library.

    Transparent heuristics. Understand every signal.

    This tool identifies price patterns; it does not predict certainty. Swings require two closed candles on each side. Eight weighted factors (max 10 points) vote bullish or bearish; the larger side sets the bias. Entry is the midpoint of the best aligned, unmitigated zone (nearest, freshest, with OB/FVG overlap preferred). The stop sits beyond the zone edge with a 0.25 ATR buffer. The target is the nearest untaken opposing swing (liquidity), falling back to 2R. A setup is only marked actionable when all six checklist gates pass; otherwise it is Wait. The walk-forward check replays the rules on the loaded history — it is in-sample and not a calibrated probability.
